main_text.p: arterijs, aliquando ab ipso cerebro ipsum humorem in articulos spinam[?] dorsi decurrere profitentur. Ille uero remotam arthritidis materiam, nec ab hepate & uenis, neque a cerebro defluere, sed ab externis partibus capitis extra caluam positis deriuare his uerbis conatur ostendere. Errat profecto (inquit) quicunque ex intimis partibus illum in articulos irrumpere putant. Quomodo enim a uisceribus intimisque sedibus possit humor syncerus aliquispiam peruenas ferri? aut qui sanguini permistus erat, il[?] linc per ora uenarum in articulos purus ex cidere? aut si etiam cum humore sanguis emanat, cur in articulo collectus phlegmo nem non excitet? Sed neque humor crudus, qui per alios ductus, quam per uenas fertur in articulos, arthritim facit. Nam crudi tas in cachexia e uisceribus in pedes incubens dum tumescant, podagram non efficit. Alia igitur qua ex intimis partibus est arthritidis origo. Haec aute caput est, e quo sane pituitosus humor, isq; tenuis profluit in articulos. page.notes: Long s (s) is transcribed as s throughout. The side marks "»" at the left of the lines are printed ornaments, not text, and are omitted. "spinam" is partly overprinted and uncertain. "il[?]" at the end of the line "erat,il" is unclear. Printing errors left as printed: "linc" (for hinc?), "aute" (for autem?), "ferri?aut" with its printed question mark. The page number is printed with a ligature and read as 250.
